question: Should ClickClack add persistent manual channel ordering as a browser-local sidebar preference?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but it creates a new core navigation behavior and persistent preference that requires maintainer intent rather than automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Accept local ordering
options.body: Land the client-only preference because it avoids channel API and shared-workspace-state changes while giving each user control.

options.title: Keep alphabetical ordering
options.body: Close or defer the PR if consistent server-provided ordering is preferred over per-browser customization.

recommendation.title: Accept local ordering
recommendation.body: Land the client-only preference because it avoids channel API and shared-workspace-state changes while giving each user control.

likelyOwner.reason: The current navigation components entered main in his v0.1.0 release preparation commit, making him the strongest available owner for this sidebar product choice.
